title: Developer issues
content: This game is saved by the fact that it is a dragon ball game. Unless you plan on spending money on the game or only playing for a short time i don’t recommend it. The game focuses new players which is good but leaves old players without as many rewards for playing longer. There are many issues with the PvP system including,Overwhelming stat differences depending on if you spent money on the game, matches against ai’s which goes against the whole point of a player vs player game mode, and server issues like lag, neglected inputs, and poor matchmaking regions. There is an overwhelming push to cut out old characters and force players to summon on their new banners otherwise you have no competitive chance in PvP. Additionally, outside of pvp and the story mode, which is rarely updated, it lacks a lot of engaging PvE content. Once you have played the game long enough you notice most PvE events are just recycled events from over the years with different rewards. This leaves the casual player or people who arent into the game for its pvp aspect getting bored of the game. Overall, at points it feels like the developers are lazy and are just pushing content out every week because they have to or because they want to draw in more money,their pvp system is heavily rng and character star based along with many server issues, and it lacks content to keep the average player engaged while they still try to push for a new play base. Once again, if this were any other anime than dragon ball it would perform exceptionally bad and face far more criticism than it has now.

author: Sïsyphus
title: Not for new players or F2P
content:
Most of the game is built around PvP and Coop and new players have absolutely no chance to compete, even in lower ranks, due to long term players having significantly better characters or having those characters leveled far more than you’re able due to spending more money and playing for years. PvP has a ranking system, but not necessarily a balancing system. Those with the most money in the game will come out on top and crystals (the pull currency) are more expensive than any gacha I’ve played. The PvP aspect is 80% pay to win, 10% luck, and 10% skill (it’s not hard to master feints and dodges). Even if you get lucky and pull “Ultra” (the highest rarity and power) characters, your competition who has spent more money or been playing for 3-6 years will have the same characters but with more stars (aka more copies and therefore more powerful). 

 This is all not to mention that the current meta is characters that cancel out everything you do, making for a really annoying gameplay where whoever has Ultra SS4 Gogeta, Ultra Instinct Goku, etc. is likely to win even if they’re not even half as skilled at combat. If you don’t have these characters and money to get multiple copies, you’re screwed.

author: NoMoreBradin
title: Avoid at all costs
content: This game is increasingly more and more pay to win. The developers only care about taking your money and don’t reward your time. Units don’t reach potentially useful levels with stats and z-ability buffs until 6* (4 copies pulled of the same unit). The Zenkai system is a massive grind and to get the other 6 tiers costs ~20k CC. The step up banners and legend rising banners still use massively outdated characters in the pools and the rates are terrible. In order to complete the adventure missions for useful CC and summon tickets you need to log in 7+ times a day to collect and select new adventures in order to get all rewards. These rewards have gotten worse over time for the effort needed. There’s no way to chat with guild mates, either privately or in a group, so it’s effectively a random bunch of players unless you force a guild to use Line or Discord. PVP is its own cancer, game mechanics force you to play a certain way with impossibly long combos. Laggy matches and lag switching are common in all levels of pvp. There are a plethora of issues with the game like the repeated currency missions, inconsistent releases, and character balancing, but I believe those are far less important to address than the other main issues. author: Mother's complaint
title: Awesome game, but a few things…
content: Ive been playing this game for two years, and I can say this game is probably the most fun mobile game I’ve played. BUT theres a few things that the average newbie should know before playing. The game has a gacha system and online pvp system, so if you will to be lucky enough to pull at least one good character. You need a device strong enough to run the game. First, the developers made it very easy for new players to obtain the in-game currency (or Chrono Crystals; CC for short.) Just by completing the entire story can give enough CC to guarantee at least one good character from the Gacha System. Obtaining specific characters will be a breeze, but you have to be careful which banner (which changes every month,) you summon on. Some characters will be better than others, despite their rarity or canon power. If you want to summon on a banner because its your favorite character, then you should summon on it. BUT, if you’re a competitive gamer like me, then you should reserve your CC for two specific events. The devs release two events every year, one at the end of the year to celebrate the New Year, and another during the summer, which is for their anniversary celebration. The STRONGEST characters in the game will be released, each coming out in three parts. It’s also really easy to get CC and other resources during the celebrations, so I guarantee you will be able to summon at least one new character. Lastly, I wanna talk about how bugs, lag and glitches sometimes occur in-game. It’s not annoying enough to change the game entirely, but it does demand a powerful WiFi connection and mobile device. Be aware that if you do summons, PVP, or multiplayer events, there’s a chance that your game may stutter, or even crash. At the time of the making of this review, I had a hard time playing the game because of my old iphone. It was compatible, but it was still old and had trouble running. Still, the game is very fun, I play it almost daily.

title: My Nicest but Most Honest Opinion on DBL
content:
This game is really something. I don’t hate the game much but I wanted to write a review in order to give my honest opinion and explain the things I don’t like about the game. Mainly, chrono crystals in this review. I understand the concept of them needing to make income but $40 USD for 3.2k chrono crystals is a lot. I know people complain about this a lot but I mean it is valid. Roughly 15k chrono crystals is about what you need and a bit of luck to get a unit from a summon. Grinding these chrono crystals (I’m gonna be calling them cc from now on) free to play is very difficult and can be frustrating. For example, in this “legends festival 2023” there is a “banner” (what you use to summon on and get units) which is called “ULTRA UI SIGN GOKU MASTERY OF OMEN” which isn’t important although I have spent 8+ hours and 10k cc to get absolutely nothing, not even a featured unit. Now this isn’t coming from some random because I’ve been playing for close to 2 years. I know it is just a game but it can make you very frustrated and even rage. I mean I grind the heck out of the game and get absolute crap. I just wish the developers could make a way to sort of guarantee these units. (Not to mention the whole theory and evidence about how beginners get better units and it’s rigged). I’m just saying however that it could cause people away from the game as well. I love the game it self, so if your looking to play it for absolutely no reason and just have some little entertainment it can be a good game. The graphics are amazing and it runs well on mobile devices. (I’m on iOS). I just hope the developers can read this review and understand my concerns, not saying the game isn’t doing great. PLEASE
AND IF YOU SEE THIS (which you won’t) JUST LET US ALL HAVE THE FESTIVAL UNITS THIS YEAR! PLEASE!!!

author: Jonesy890
title: Worst PvP mobile game Ever
content:
Everything wrong with PvP in this game:

- **Zenkai/rank meta is fake balance** — At high ranks you're fighting fully awakened 14★ units a lot! Getting a unit to full 14★ requires pulling that same top-rarity unit 5-7 separate times, so when you see one, you know the opponent spent heavily to get there — and it absolutely matters in a fight. So yes be aware this game is very much pay to win. 

- **Equipment doesn't actually matter, and it should** — You'll lose to someone running zero equips or A-rank-and-below gear while you're fully equipped (with Godly pure equips and everything). Two players on the same featured anniversary unit should not be performing identically when one has far superior equipment. That's not balance, that's rigged.

- **Tier boost narrows the entire roster on purpose** — There are around 700 characters in this game and you'll realistically see maybe 10 of them a season, mostly the same 9 top units remixed into different team comps. Anything outside featured tier boost basically doesn't exist in ranked. It's cheaper for Bandai to narrow the meta than to actually balance the full cast.

- **Stat gaps are absurd** — Some units run 300%+ damage and damage guard simultaneously, while others in the same game can't even hit 100% on one of those stats. This gets brought up as a complaint every single season and nothing changes.

- **Matches feel decided before the timer starts** — With how skewed stats, equipment impact, and tier boost access are, it doesn't feel like a skill-based fight so much as a stat check with extra steps. Can you exploit all the terrible PvP mechanics to utterly control the match? Or are you running the newest units with the best kits and fighting with them on autopilot? No matter how you slice it. The game is 8 years in and the PvP system has been broken from the start and they’re never going to fix it. 

- **Cover Change vs. Cover Nullification is broken design** — Cover Nullification durations are so long that opponents can null your cover, land 2-6 cards on you, and switch out before your Cover Change ever matters. With cover null attached to main abilities, gauge fill, AND battlefield entry on top of that, the one mechanic meant to save you from infinite pressure is neutralized constantly. This is why matches so consistently turn into one sided fights…see below

- **PvP is really Pv1** — Lose one neutral exchange and you can spend the rest of the 180 seconds watching your units get combo'd apart while the other player just plays the game. With all the cover-null and the quick strike attacks being able to interrupt any action in the game and bounce you up and down the map, you can genuinely find yourself watching 30-45+ seconds of your opponent smashing your team with no way of getting out of it. 

- **Character design is stagnant and predatory** — Old units barely get rebalanced. Instead Bandai just sells a new unit, then sells the next banner as a hard counter to it. Same sales cycle the entire time I've played, under a year.

- **PvE content runs dry fast** — Once you're through it, there's nothing to fall back on besides the broken PvP loop.

Save your time, money, and sanity — this is one of the worst mobile game experiences I've had after years of gaming.
